S.FORM: alang Dihekoay ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Ikekami go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 76 buwan, 198 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 84% kyan ku 167 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 16% kyan ku 31 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis80%, Puyuma1%, Setik1%, binah lihuyan s'uli3%. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Dihekoay hya' ga Cicala'ay. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Dihekoay ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Dihekoay ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ *iħekoaj ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu ikekami ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ]** pujuma* [s|ɕ]etik* βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli* rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na *iħekoaj ħjaʔ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]i[ʦ|ʨ]alaʔaj reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ *iħekoaj ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ *iħekoaj ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
